name: What preparation is required before flooring installers arrive?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is required before flooring installers arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before installers arrive, clear the installation area by removing all furniture, appliances, and personal belongings. For existing flooring, if you are not having us remove it, ensure it's taken up and the subfloor is clean and free of debris. Ensure pathways are clear for material delivery. If installing hardwood, materials often need to acclimate in your home for several days prior to installation. We will provide a specific checklist for your project to ensure a smooth process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before installers arrive, clear all furniture from the area, ensure existing flooring is removed (if not handled by us), and make sure pathways are clear for material delivery.
